why_this_is_written_before_any_computati: The project's chronic failure is searching until something looks good and counting the trials afterwards. These configurations are fixed now, before the signals exist. Anything tested beyond this list is a new trial and must be added to the cumulative count, not folded in silently.
origin: Step 216. These are the anomalies most orthogonal to every strategy this project holds, from the OSAP screen, restricted to those computable from data already on disk.

data_feasibility_established_before_regi.sec_quarterly_decisions: 15, of which 11 usable after a one-year year-over-year lag
data_feasibility_established_before_regi.consequence: Seasonal momentum requires at least five years of history to produce one observation and is therefore not computable on the single-stock panel. It is registered on the ETF panel only. The accounting-change family has 11 quarterly observations, which cannot support a portfolio backtest, so it is registered as an information-coefficient measurement and explicitly not as a strategy test.

family_a_seasonal_momentum.definition: Heston-Sadka same-calendar-month effect: mean return in the same calendar month across a declared window of prior years, ranked cross-sectionally, one-week execution delay

family_b_accounting_change.definition: Year-over-year change in a single accounting quantity, sector-neutral cross-sectional rank, measured against the panel's existing forward label
family_b_accounting_change.measured_as: rank information coefficient only; 11 quarterly observations cannot support a backtest and none will be run

gates.primary_breadth_gate: absolute correlation below 0.30 against every strategy this project already holds, measured on overlapping months. A configuration failing this is rejected regardless of its return.
gates.secondary_significance_gate: Bonferroni over the 10 declared trials, so p < 0.005 per test
gates.gate_order: breadth first, return second. A configuration that fails the breadth gate is not evaluated for return.
gates.family_b_note: Family B is expected to fail the significance gate on sample size alone. It is registered to measure, not to promote.

cumulative_trial_accounting: These 10 stack on every configuration previously searched in this project. No result here may be reported without stating that.
promotion_authority: none. This registry measures and never authorises trading.
revision_policy: Adding a configuration creates v2 and marks this version superseded rather than editing it.
